strings.name: Volodymyr Zelenskyy
strings.role: President of Ukraine · Wartime leadership and European diplomacy
strings.summary: After studying law, Zelenskyy worked in comedy and television, gaining wide recognition through Servant of the People before being elected president in 2019. Following Russia’s full-scale invasion in 2022, his wartime communication and pursuit of international support became globally prominent. He also pursued EU accession. Domestic accountability remains important: a 2025 law weakening anti-corruption bodies was reversed after protests.
strings.coverageNote: Research cutoff: 13 November 2026; selected career milestones cover 1978–2025. Presidential activity records from November 2026 confirm his role and living status. The ongoing war and EU negotiations are not presented as concluded.
strings.facts.fact-01.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-02.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-02.value: Kyiv National Economic University: law degree, 2000
strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Wartime public leadership
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: After the 2022 full-scale invasion, sought international support through regular public addresses and diplomacy.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: European integration
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Ukraine formally opened EU accession negotiations during his presidency in 2024. Opening talks does not mean membership has been achieved.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Restores anti-corruption independence
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Signed legislation reversing earlier restrictions on two anti-corruption bodies after public protests and pressure from European partners.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Ukraine opens EU accession talks
strings.timeline.event-02.text: The EU and Ukraine held their first intergovernmental conference to formally launch membership negotiations.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Full-scale war begins
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Russia launched its full-scale invasion. He continued as president and used public addresses to seek international support.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Takes office as president
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Sworn in as Ukraine’s sixth president after winning the election on 21 April.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Stars in Servant of the People
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Played a teacher who unexpectedly becomes president in a political satire, widening his public recognition.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Moves into television production
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Kvartal 95 began producing television programmes; he served as executive producer and worked in film and television.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Completes law degree
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Graduated from Kyiv National Economic University, then continued in entertainment and production.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Born in Kryvyi Rih
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Born in the then Soviet Union, later studied locally and began comedy performances.
strings.influence.rationale: Moved from entertainment to Ukraine’s presidency, with global influence through wartime national mobilisation and international diplomacy.
